title: Drainage course.
officialText:
A drainage course shall consist of washed gravel, crushed natural stone or other suitable drainage
medium acceptable to the engineer. Recycled Concrete Aggregate is not acceptable for use in a drainage course where a subsoil
drainage system is used.
